projects.title: Line Follower Robot
projects.shortDescription: Autonomous robot using Arduino Nano and PID for smooth tracking.
projects.longDescription: Implemented a PID (Proportional-Integral-Derivative) control algorithm using an Arduino Nano. This calculates the error value from the IR sensor array and adjusts motor speed continuously for smooth path correction.
projects.challenge: To build a high-speed robot capable of following a complex black line on a white surface without losing trajectory on sharp turns.
projects.solution: Implemented a PID (Proportional-Integral-Derivative) control algorithm using an Arduino Nano. This calculates the error value from the IR sensor array and adjusts motor speed continuously for smooth path correction.

projects.title: ESP32 Wi-Fi Rover
projects.shortDescription: Remote controlled rover via Wi-Fi with OLED feedback.
projects.longDescription: Built a web-controlled surveillance rover. The ESP32 hosts a web server that serves a control interface to any connected phone/laptop. It displays connection status and IP address on an onboard OLED screen.
projects.challenge: To construct a low-latency web-controlled vehicle with onboard feedback.
projects.solution: Designed a mobile web dashboard hosting control buttons. Used WebSocket communication on the ESP32 to receive controls and updated an SSD1306 OLED screen over I2C with current statuses.

projects.title: RC Soccer Bot
projects.shortDescription: High-torque robot designed for speed and responsiveness.
projects.longDescription: Engineered a robust chassis with high-torque gear motors to push objects (balls) while maintaining high agility. Optimized weight distribution for traction.
projects.challenge: To design a chassis and drive system that provides strong pushing power while keeping the robot highly agile and responsive.
projects.solution: Engineered a robust custom chassis using lightweight acrylic. Implemented high-torque DC gear motors and high-traction wheels, optimized center of gravity, and controlled it using a custom transmitter/receiver setup.
